import type { FreeCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { attachFreeControl, createFreeCamera } from "@babylonjs/lite";

type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };

export interface Walkthrough { readonly camera: FreeCamera; jumpTo(eye: Vec, target: Vec): void; dispose(): void }

const EPS = 1e-6;
const MAX_PITCH = Math.PI / 2 - 0.01;

function asVec(vec: unknown): Vec { return vec as Vec; }

export function createWalkthrough(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, scene: SceneContext, eye: Vec, target: Vec): Walkthrough {
  const camera = createFreeCamera(eye, target);
  const sceneWithCamera = scene as unknown as { camera: FreeCamera | null };
  sceneWithCamera.camera = camera;

  const pos = camera.position as unknown as Vec;
  const tgt = camera.target as unknown as Vec;

  function applyPose(eye: Vec, target: Vec): void {
    const safeEye = { x: Number.isFinite(eye.x) ? eye.x : 0, ...};
    const safeTarget = { x: Number.isFinite(target.x) ? target.x : safeEye.x, ...};
    const dx = safeTarget.x - safeEye.x; ...
    const len = Math.hypot(dx,dy,dz);
    let targetVec = safeTarget;
    let keepPassedTarget = true;
    if (!Number.isFinite(len) || len < EPS) { targetVec = {x:safeEye.x,y:safeEye.y,z:safeEye.z+1}; keepPassedTarget=false; }
    const probe = createFreeCamera(safeEye, targetVec);
    let yaw = probe._yaw; let pitch = probe._pitch;
    const horizontal = Math.hypot(targetVec.x - safeEye.x, targetVec.z - safeEye.z);
    if (!Number.isFinite(yaw)) { yaw = Math.atan2(targetVec.x - safeEye.x, targetVec.z - safeEye.z); keepPassedTarget=false; }
    if (!Number.isFinite(pitch)) { pitch = Math.atan2(targetVec.y - safeEye.y, horizontal); keepPassedTarget=false; }
    if (pitch > MAX_PITCH) { pitch = MAX_PITCH; keepPassedTarget=false; } else if (pitch < -MAX_PITCH) { pitch = -MAX_PITCH; keepPassedTarget=false; }
    pos.x = safeEye.x; pos.y = safeEye.y; pos.z = safeEye.z;
    if (keepPassedTarget) { tgt.x = targetVec.x; ... } else { const cp = Math.cos(pitch); tgt.x = safeEye.x + Math.sin(yaw)*cp; ... }
    camera._yaw = yaw; camera._pitch = pitch;
  }

  applyPose(eye, target);
  let disposed = false;
  let detach = attachFreeControl(camera, canvas, scene);

  function jumpTo(eye: Vec, target: Vec): void {
    applyPose(eye, target);
    // If the controls have been disposed, jumpTo still updates the camera pose but does not reattach listeners.
    // If controls are active, they now use the new _yaw/_pitch and target.
  }

  function dispose(): void {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;
    detach();
    detach = () => {};
  }

  return { camera, jumpTo, dispose };
}

import type { FreeCamera, SceneContext } from "@babylonjs/lite";
import { attachFreeControl, createFreeCamera } from "@babylonjs/lite";

type Vec = { x: number; y: number; z: number };

export interface Walkthrough {
  readonly camera: FreeCamera;
  jumpTo(eye: Vec, target: Vec): void;
  dispose(): void;
}

const EPS = 1e-6;
const MAX_PITCH = Math.PI / 2 - 0.01;

function finiteNumber(value: number): number {
  return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : 0;
}

function asWritableVec(vec: unknown): Vec {
  return vec as Vec;
}

export function createWalkthrough(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, scene: SceneContext, eye: Vec, target: Vec): Walkthrough {
  const camera = createFreeCamera(eye, target);
  const sceneWithCamera = scene as unknown as { camera: FreeCamera | null };
  sceneWithCamera.camera = camera;

  const position = asWritableVec(camera.position);
  const targetRef = asWritableVec(camera.target);

  function applyPose(nextEye: Vec, nextTarget: Vec): void {
    const eyeVec = {
      x: finiteNumber(nextEye.x),
      y: finiteNumber(nextEye.y),
      z: finiteNumber(nextEye.z),
    };
    const targetVec = {
      x: finiteNumber(nextTarget.x),
      y: finiteNumber(nextTarget.y),
      z: finiteNumber(nextTarget.z),
    };

    const dx = targetVec.x - eyeVec.x;
    const dy = targetVec.y - eyeVec.y;
    const dz = targetVec.z - eyeVec.z;
    const length = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz);

    let lookTarget = targetVec;
    let keepGivenTarget = true;

    if (!Number.isFinite(length) || length < EPS) {
      lookTarget = { x: eyeVec.x, y: eyeVec.y, z: eyeVec.z + 1 };
      keepGivenTarget = false;
    }

    // createFreeCamera knows the library's yaw/pitch conventions, so ask it rather than guessing.
    const probe = createFreeCamera(eyeVec, lookTarget);
    let yaw = probe._yaw;
    let pitch = probe._pitch;

    const horizontal = Math.hypot(lookTarget.x - eyeVec.x, lookTarget.z - eyeVec.z);
    if (!Number.isFinite(yaw)) {
      yaw = Math.atan2(lookTarget.x - eyeVec.x, lookTarget.z - eyeVec.z);
      keepGivenTarget = false;
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(pitch)) {
      pitch = Math.atan2(lookTarget.y - eyeVec.y, horizontal);
      keepGivenTarget = false;
    }

    if (pitch > MAX_PITCH) {
      pitch = MAX_PITCH;
      keepGivenTarget = false;
    } else if (pitch < -MAX_PITCH) {
      pitch = -MAX_PITCH;
      keepGivenTarget = false;
    }

    position.x = eyeVec.x;
    position.y = eyeVec.y;
    position.z = eyeVec.z;

    if (keepGivenTarget) {
      targetRef.x = lookTarget.x;
      targetRef.y = lookTarget.y;
      targetRef.z = lookTarget.z;
    } else {
      // attachFreeControl rebuilds target one unit ahead of position from _yaw/_pitch; match that when we had to adjust pitch.
      const cosPitch = Math.cos(pitch);
      targetRef.x = eyeVec.x + Math.sin(yaw) * cosPitch;
      targetRef.y = eyeVec.y + Math.sin(pitch);
      targetRef.z = eyeVec.z + Math.cos(yaw) * cosPitch;
    }

    camera._yaw = yaw;
    camera._pitch = pitch;
  }

  applyPose(eye, target);

  let disposed = false;
  let detach = attachFreeControl(camera, canvas, scene);

  function jumpTo(nextEye: Vec, nextTarget: Vec): void {
    applyPose(nextEye, nextTarget);
    // If controls are still attached, they now resume from the updated _yaw/_pitch and target.
    // If dispose() has already run, jumpTo only updates the camera pose and does not reattach listeners.
  }

  function dispose(): void {
    if (disposed) return;
    disposed = true;
    detach();
    detach = () => {};
  }

  return { camera, jumpTo, dispose };
}
